LESSON: KENYAN FOLK DANCE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.3: Kenyan Folk Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Kenyan Folk Dance
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it necessary to perform a folk dance?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance
2. describe components of a Kenyan folk dance
3. discuss the roles of folk dance in the community
4. perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community
